source: البرنامج الوطني للتطعيم – المركز الوطني لمكافحة الأمراض، ليبيا (مسودة للمراجعة)
reviewNote: DRAFT. Confirmed from public sources: birth doses (BCG, hepatitis B, oral polio — NCDC newborn poster); DTaP at 2, 4, 6 and 18 months; rotavirus at 2, 4, 6 months, not after 8 months; varicella and hepatitis A at 15 months (added 2023). Every dose with "verify": true is our best guess and MUST be checked against the official NCDC schedule (vaccine names/combinations, PCV booster, MMR ages, meningococcal vaccine, school-entry boosters) and signed off by a Libyan paediatrician before release.
